page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e-c4m1.large is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.e server family. It features 2 vCPUs on a shared CPU allocation model, powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to manage its virtualization layer.

This instance is configured with 0.5 GB of system memory, which translates to a low memory allocation of 0.25 GB per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage must be attached externally. Additionally, the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, highlighting significant resource constraints for network-heavy or data-intensive applications.

Given its shared CPU allocation and minimal memory footprint, the ecs.e-c4m1.large is positioned as a highly budget-focused option. It is designed for workloads with very low resource requirements. Appropriate use cases are limited to lightweight background tasks, basic automation scripts, simple testing environments, or minimal microservices that do not require persistent local storage or high network throughput.
